01: The Operator

The edge is discipline.

Based in Dubai, UAE

Fahad Riaz is a Dubai-based entrepreneur recognised for driving record-breaking sales and market presence across Milele's multi-vertical ecosystem.

His edge isn't noise; it's the discipline of turning complex, cross-border challenges into structured systems that scale. From tax-free vehicle export and procurement to car rental, luxury real estate, and fintech, every vertical is engineered to strengthen the next.

Today Milele stocks thousands of vehicles across Dubai and Antwerp, exporting close to 10,000 cars a year to more than 50 countries across Africa, Asia, and the Middle East. But for Fahad, scale is only the starting line.

“Build systems. Create leverage. Expand across continents.”
Operational Excellence Disciplined Growth Long-Term Value

03: The Journey

From one idea to an empire.

The Start

A trader's mindset

Beginning in the automotive trade with a simple principle inherited the old-fashioned way: show up, do good work, keep your word.

Scale

Building Milele Motors

Scaling tax-free vehicle export into a $350M operation moving over 10,000 cars annually to 50+ countries.

Expand

Mobility beyond export

Launching car rental operations in the UAE, extending the brand from trading into everyday premium experiences.

Diversify

Real estate & development

Moving into luxury property and ground-up development, converting momentum into durable, asset-backed value.

Now

An enduring organisation

Building a global company that reshapes industries and makes everyday life simpler and faster, leaving a mark the world won't forget.

04: Off The Clock

Discipline, on and off duty.
